hub.notes: askp is now fueledby. Install this Hub: it replaces askp Hub and moves your plugins, data and theme across.

plugins.name: V/A
plugins.tagline: Analog-style channel strip: up to sixteen slots of Pre, Tape, Comp, Tone, Space, Echo, Drive, Amp, Pitch and more.
plugins.notes: 0.6.3: askp is now fueledby. DAWs list it under fueledby; saved sessions, presets and your theme carry over. 0.6.0: Shared fueledby themes: theme menu next to the light/dark button, one choice for all fueledby plugins. Sibil device shows the standalone's timeline graph and S Balance line. 0.5.1: a Hide graph button folds the graph into a slim bar so the knobs fill the panel (open by default, saved per session). 0.5.0: every control on screen; band EQ is now Tone with Character, Tube and Tilt.

plugins.name: Atrium
plugins.tagline: Draw a room, place every track in it, and walk a listener through it, in stereo or binaural 3D.
plugins.notes: 0.2.1: askp is now fueledby. DAWs list it under fueledby; saved sessions, presets and your theme carry over. 0.2.0: One kind of plugin: put Atrium on each track (no Room bus). Every track shares one room, listener and output mode; edit them on any track. Headphones mode is binaural 3D (front/back, above/below). Draw any room shape with curved walls, add furniture, pillars, doors; walls and tall objects block sound. Save your own rooms, record a listener walk against the song, export impulse responses, Air control. 0.1 sessions still load (an old Room bus plays its tail and can be turned into a track).
